goal: Splits ConnectBlock into a mutating version and a new const-index TestConnectBlock, removing the fJustCheck flag so check-only calls no longer need a dummy mutable CBlockIndex.
reviewability: Ready to review, all review comments applied and CI issues were merge-conflict related, now fixed.
agreement: Concept ACK from a reviewer who liked the mutability clarity (l0rinc), but a maintainer flagged that the refactor still leaves Chainstate-level side effects during check-only calls and pointed toward a broader side-effect-free redesign (purpleKarrot).
Author agrees the deeper redesign is the right direction but argues this PR is a compatible small step, no explicit objection to merging this PR itself.

result.summary: This PR refactors Chainstate::ConnectBlock by splitting out a shared internal ConnectBlockChecks helper, and introduces a new TestConnectBlock method that takes a const CBlockIndex& instead of the mutable pointer plus fJustCheck flag used previously. The check-only call site (TestBlockValidity) and the fuzz harness are updated to use the new method. The change is described as a pure refactor with no behavior change.
result.problem: The check-only mode of ConnectBlock took a mutable CBlockIndex* even though it never mutates it, forcing callers to construct a dummy mutable index and relying on an easy-to-misuse fJustCheck flag. This is a code-hygiene issue felt by reviewers and future maintainers of this consensus-critical function, and is a stepping stone toward the stated goal in issue #35904 of a side-effect-free validation library.

open_concerns: purpleKarrot noted that TestConnectBlock still mutates Chainstate-level state (num_blocks_total, timing counters, validation cache) despite being 'check-only', and pointed to issue #35904 for a fuller side-effect-free redesign; author acknowledged this is a valid deeper issue but argues the current PR is a compatible, small, low-risk step and has not made further code changes addressing the Chainstate-level mutation itself.
l0rinc suggested keeping the PR very small/trivially-correct and splitting it further, referencing a local split branch; author has not yet split the PR.
resolved_concerns: l0rinc's inline suggestions (reuse pindex->GetBlockHash(), pass index by const reference, update stale comments) were all applied by the author in the 2026-09-11 force-push.
CI fuzz build failures were diagnosed as silent merge conflicts with an unrelated merged PR (#35850) and fixed by rebasing.

result.card: This PR splits Chainstate::ConnectBlock into a shared ConnectBlockChecks helper plus a new TestConnectBlock method with a const CBlockIndex&, removing the fJustCheck flag and the need for callers to construct a dummy mutable index for check-only validation. It is a pure refactor with no stated behavior change, aimed as a small step toward the side-effect-free validation library discussed in issue #35904 and compatible with the in-progress #35187 kernel work. A maintainer, purpleKarrot, pointed out the refactor does not eliminate remaining Chainstate-level side effects (counters, timing, validation cache) during 'check-only' calls, a concern the author accepts as valid but treats as out of scope for this incremental step. Reviewer l0rinc gave a Concept ACK and supplied inline suggestions that the author has since applied in a rebase; CI failures were diagnosed as merge-conflict artifacts and fixed. The PR touches only validation.cpp/h and a fuzz harness call site, is Ready for review, and its importance rests mainly on unblocking future refactoring rather than any immediate correctness or performance gain.
